scope: Real producers for announcements, tips and recommendations via platform-admin email campaigns; communication summaries remain unimplemented.
implementation: Platform-admin-only draft, recipient-count preview and explicit publish endpoints are wired into production repository/service/handler initialization and authAdmin routes. Server moderators cannot use this gate.

Server-generated immutable campaign ID; bounded plain text and escaped rendering; published audit actor/time/count survive retries. Publication and per-recipient queue inserts commit atomically; consent/verified-address eligibility and per-user campaign dedupe apply.

Expiry is persisted on jobs and checked at claim and immediately before provider send. Provider send already in progress cannot be recalled. No recipient addresses are fetched for audience selection or exposed in preview.

Recommendations additionally require explicit privacy.experiencePersonalization=true at enqueue, campaign audience selection and delivery. Missing/malformed/false personalization denies recommendations; other categories and security email remain unchanged. Tests cover revocation after queueing and malformed/missing consent.

Admin UI supports persisted account/server-scoped draft, plain-text preview, eligible count, explicit confirmation, same-ID retry/reconciliation, discard confirmation and account/session/admin-revocation fences. Publishing is presented as queueing, never confirmed email delivery.
